    Injectivity of the intervals k_{[*,t]} (Lemma 2.1, Step 1) #

    For t ∈ I_* and a representation M, evaluation at t identifies morphisms M ⟶ k_{[*,t]} with linear functionals on M(t): a functional λ gives the morphism with components λ ∘ M(s ≤ t) for s ≤ t. Since evaluation and duality of vector spaces are exact, k_{[*,t]} is injective; in particular P i and Y are injective in Rep k I.
